_comment: Hand-maintained. Each bullet of PROPAGATION.md's standard child doctrine block (the <!-- floor:begin -->/<!-- floor:end --> region) that summarises a NAMED source-doc section, keyed by a short stable id. `anchor` is the bullet's own bold lead-in text, copied verbatim from the block — it is how this map finds 'the same bullet' in both PROPAGATION.md's region and docs/build/templates/CLAUDE.md's stamped copy without needing a hidden id in either file (they are meant to read as plain doctrine prose, not machine markup). `sources` lists the doc section(s) that bullet claims to summarise, identified by the exact Markdown heading line it is filed under (level included, so a heading demoted or promoted a level still resolves by text but the map's own heading string documents which level was intended). Not every block bullet is listed: three carry no doc-section citation at all (source-and-drift, estate-resources, this-repos-visibility) — see tools/blockscan.py's module docstring for why those are out of this check's scope, not merely unmapped by oversight.
